svg.title: An event its own question ends
svg.desc: On the stormy night in Vale, every way to a third spot crosses two others first. The map shows them as the game draws Vale that night, Garet still at his chest: the first spot a strip of ground just west of him, the second a strip west of that, and the third two places further north. On the first, Isaac hears Garet struggling with his things. On the second, Garet calls after him and joins the party, and the game notes that he has joined. The third spot holds an older version of Garet joining, which first asks whether Garet has joined. By the time the leader can stand there the answer is always yes, so the event ends at once, and its lines, among them "Are you trapped, too?", are never shown.
svg.text: VALE ON THE STORMY NIGHT: THE ONLY WAY ALONG

g.text: Garet calls after him and joins
the game notes: Garet has joined
An older version of Garet joining
Its first question: has Garet joined?
Always yes by now, so it ends at once.
"Are you trapped, too?" is never shown.
Every way to the third spot crosses the first
two, so their events have always run first.
